title: My published game - Soul Stake
author: DiegoSilverhand
selftext:
\*\*Soul Stake\*\* is an adult fantasy card game of high-stakes duels, risk, and spiritual energy. At its core lies the familiar goal of 21: reach the exact target number or get closer to it than your opponent. But here, luck and card draws alone are never enough — trump cards, skills, and each rival’s unique abilities can turn the tide of any match.



You play as Kairen Wade, the Jade Wanderer, who accidentally frees nine powerful spirits from the ancient gaming table Shen Jiu. They steal his spiritual power and scatter across the world. To reclaim what was taken, Kairen must track down each spirit and defeat her in the Sacred Game.



Every round is a tense duel. Draw a card, stand, play a skill, or risk everything for a perfect score. Trumps let you alter point totals, defend, purge effects, swap cards, reveal the top of the deck, or even change the target number for the round.



Each spirit opponent has her own personality, play style, and personal deck. Some play cautiously, others press hard with aggression, manipulate trumps, or force you into costly mistakes. Victory demands more than luck — it requires reading your rival, calculated risk, and a well-built skill deck.



Defeat the spirits, unlock new cards, advance through progression stages, open the gallery, and reclaim your stolen power one hard-fought win at a time.



\*\*Features:\*\*

\- Duel-based card system built on the rules of 21

\- Trump cards and skill cards that reshape every match

\- Nine spirit rivals, each with a distinct play style

\- Spiritual energy stakes in every round

\- Fully customizable player skill deck

\- New cards unlocked through victories, achievements, and progress

\- Story mode set in the fantasy world of the Jade Empire

\- Single duels, Survival mode, and a full tutorial

\- Individual progress tracking and unlockable gallery for each rival

\- Adult strip-duel progression featuring original 18+ characters
